description: This file defines the GDPR email controller class for the OpenCart admin module, handling GDPR-related email notifications such as export, approval, denial, and removal notifications. It includes methods for composing and queuing emails based on GDPR actions with detailed data collection on customer info, addresses, orders, and IP addresses.

classes.name: Gdpr
classes.description: Controller class for handling GDPR email notifications within the OpenCart admin panel, managing export, approval, denial, and removal email workflows, including data gathering and email queuing.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that routes GDPR actions based on the provided parameters, triggering specific email workflows accordingly.

methods.name: export
methods.description: Constructs and queues an export GDPR email, including customer info, addresses, orders, IP addresses, and store details.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Constructs and queues an approval GDPR email, notifying customers of approval status.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Constructs and queues a denial GDPR email, informing customers of denial based on GDPR action.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Constructs and queues a removal GDPR email, informing customers their data has been deleted or removed.
